Name: ASLAN Sparkle Colour 12325 Light Gold
Short description: ASLAN SC12325 Light Gold Sparkle Colour is a 350 micron polyester film coated with an eye catching surface of glitter particles offering intense sparkling light reflection.
Description:
ASLAN SC12325 Light Gold Sparkle Colour is a 350 micron polyester film coated with an eye catching surface of glitter particles offering intense sparkling light reflection.

Structure:
  • 100µm PET protection liner that also acts as an application tape
  • 350µm PET coated with glitter
  • Water based acrylic adhesive
  • 140g/s2 silicone paper PE coated on both sides
Suitability:
  • ASLAN Sparkle Colour is ideal for interior decoration, retail displays, POS and furniture renovation
  • The perfect solution for creating seasonal decorations at Christmas and Valentines Day
  • This pvc free film is coated with a strong, transparent adhesive that offers good long term use
  • Unlike its rivals, the ASLAN SC123 is ideal for cad cutting. This is done by cutting and weeding in reverse through the backing liner and using the transparent top protective liner as an application tape
  • Features a transparent top protective liner which aids application and enables the use of squeegees
Advantages:
  • Most glitter films come with just a backing liner. Anyone familiar with the application of glitter vinyl will know that this can make them extremely tricky to apply, as using a squeegee to create a smooth and even application can create a horrible glittery mess. The use of an application tape to avoid this is pretty much out of the question. However, as well as a backing liner ASLAN has cleverly given SparkleColour a transparent top protective liner too which does the job of an application tape and allows for a much cleaner application. This also means the film is ideal for cad cutting, by cutting and weeding in reverse through the backing liner
  • For full surface coverage simply remove the backing liner and apply the Sparkle Colour to the surface easily using a squeegee. Once in position and squeegeed on, just remove the protective top liner
  • Suggested cap height of minimum 10mm
  • Residue free removal from smooth flat surfaces
  • PVC Free
  • Easy to apply and no need for rollers
Ink Compatibility:
    UV

Technical Information:

Want to know what makes this different to Static Cling?

Static Cling Vinyl is completely free of adhesive. It is the static electrical charge within the film that attracts (clings) it to a surface that has an opposite charge.
Our Glue Free Adhesion films work in a completely different way using something called 'van der Waals force'. The surface of these films comprise of a microporous layer of carbon nanotubes that expand the surface area of the film and gives it a grip like feel. When the film is applied to a smooth surface this layer aligns itself to the surface forming a strong 'grip' but when peeled off at an angle this grip is broken

Name: F-Sign Platinum 800 White
Short description: F-Sign Platinum 800 White polymeric self-adhesive vinyl designed for long term vehicle graphics and exterior signage with an outdoor durability of 10 years.
Description:
F-Sign Platinum 800 White polymeric self-adhesive vinyl is designed for long term vehicle graphics and exterior signage.

Structure:
  • 65µm Polymeric calendered PVC
  • Transparent solvent based adhesive - Permanent
  • Clay coated kraft paper liner - 120gm2 or Micro embossed PE coated kraft paper liner - 140gm2
Suitability:
  • Excellent conformability to 3D curved surfaces (for extremely curved surfaces or corrugations this vinyl should be cut and applied with an overlap)
  • This high performance vinyl is designed for branding on vehicles, window graphics and all exterior or interior signage and displays
  • The high gloss face film has a high level of opacity and is engineered to enhance corporate branding projects
  • Outdoor durability of up to 10 years
Advantages:
  • Very cohesive solvent based adhesive provides excellent dimensional stability and water resistance for long term durability
  • This film is available with both the standard kraft liner that allows for wet or dry application as well as the Airflow liner for dry, easy to apply and bubble free application
  • Colour referencing for colour system swatches and competitor matching - see below
  • Fire Rated to Euroclass DIN EN 13501-1:2019-05 with classification B-s1-d0
  • REACH & RoHS compliant
Technical Information:
Categories: Sign & Display Vinyl > Signmaking Vinyl > Ritrama F-Sign Platinum Range 10 Year Polymeric Sign Vinyl
